column1: # Module 02 — tutor setup. Format: Text<TAB>tags. Card law: anki/CARD-RULES.md
What is the illusion of knowing? Feeling you could do {{c1::what you only watched being done}}.
What is the single best-evidenced study technique? {{c1::Active recall — answering from memory}}.
How does spaced repetition schedule reviews? {{c1::Just before you'd forget}}, at {{c2::stretching intervals}}.
What does Anki's FSRS algorithm do? {{c1::Learns YOUR forgetting curve and schedules each card's next review}}.
What are your three fixed Anki numbers? Retention {{c1::0.90}} · {{c2::10}} new cards/day · backlog cap {{c3::20 reviews + bulk-suspend}}.
What is the Anki pipeline law (amended 26/08/2026)? {{c1::Sessions draft AND import; Samrath reviews and vetoes}}.
What is the wall rule? {{c1::30+ minutes of genuine struggle}} before Claude may even hint.
What is the dojo, in one sentence? {{c1::20 daily minutes hunting planted bugs}} — the interview muscle, built in reps.
What is the dojo level-up rule? {{c1::Three clean days}} → level up; a brutal day means {{c2::stay, never drop}}.
What are the three L0 dojo bug classes that recur in real code? {{c1::Swallowed error branches}} · {{c2::unverified side-effects before destructive ops}} · {{c3::wrong filter predicate}}.
What is the restart ritual after a broken streak? {{c1::ONE 20-minute dojo}}; never {{c2::two zero-days in a row}}.
Why does the study journal track only numbers and instruments? {{c1::Feelings don't grade — data answers imposter panic}}.
What is the weekly outage-test question? {{c1::"If Anthropic went down for a week, what % of my productivity survives?"}} — the number must trend up.
When is Claude banned entirely? {{c1::Struggle reps}} · {{c2::the 20% AI-free quota}} · {{c3::the first 30 minutes of any wall}}.
What is tutor contract rule 1? {{c1::Never show a full solution}} — concepts + a different example, then I do mine.
Why does 20 min/day beat 2 h/week for the dojo? {{c1::Spacing applies to skills — short daily reps build pattern recognition}}.
